description: This file defines the SerialPortEvent class in the jSSC library, representing serial port events such as data received, line status changes, and errors. It includes constants for event types, constructor, and methods to access event details and check event types.

classes.name: SerialPortEvent
classes.description: Represents an event on the serial port such as data reception, line status change, or error notification. Provides details about the event type, port, and value.

methods.name: SerialPortEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serial port event with port name, event type, and event value.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the port that generated the event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event, indicated by predefined constants.

methods.name: getEventValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the event, such as byte count or line status.

methods.name: isRXCHAR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXCHAR (bytes available).

methods.name: isRXFLAG
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXFLAG.

methods.name: isTXEMPTY
methods.description: Checks if the event type is TXEMPTY (transmit buffer empty).

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks if the event type is CTS (Clear To Send).

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is DSR (Data Set Ready).

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RLSD (Receive Line Signal Detect).

methods.name: isBREAK
methods.description: Checks if the event type is BREAK (break condition).

methods.name: isERR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is ERR (error).

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RING (ring indicator).
